body: screen time says 11 hours today. it's broken, i was barely on. everything is fine.
my productivity hack is checking the cat's follower count instead of my bank balance. one of them goes up.
shipped three side projects this week. wrote a thread for each. two of them have users. one of the users is my mom.
day 4 of only eating instant noodles. posting every bowl. the broth is my therapist now.
opened the app at 9 to check one thing. it's 2pm. still don't know what the thing was.
cat walked across the keyboard during a video interview. posted the clip before the call ended. they said she seemed engaged.
day 7. switched to the spicy one, the replies wanted it. same noodles, it just hurts now.
DOLR down 3% today. holding. refreshed the chart about 200 times. this is what holding means.
turned off notifications for a day. lasted 40 minutes. didn't miss anything, which was worse.
board meeting at 5am. i was already up, scrolling. motion to move breakfast earlier passed unanimously.
ranked flavor 88 at 3am. chicken, but from a different country. 6/10. the replies say 7.
people keep asking what i do for a living. i prompt, then i post about prompting. mostly the second one.
grocery store took out the last staffed checkout. first thing i'd said out loud in four days and it was to the screen. it says "we're here to help."
slow week. the cat has started sitting in the empty office chair like she's waiting for someone. i've posted it every hour.
corner store raised noodles by 10 cents. first time in my life i've noticed 10 cents. thread below (1/9)
bought the DOLR dip again at 4am. there have been a lot of dips. i was awake for most of them.
read about 300 replies about the election and now i know less than before.
applied to eleven jobs today. refreshed my notifications more times than that. the cat applied to none and is doing fine.
found a pack of the discontinued shrimp flavor at the back of the shelf. saving it for 1k followers. not sure what else it would be for anymore.
polls open at 7 tomorrow. first time in weeks i'll be up at 7 on purpose instead of still up from the night before.
voted. long line, nobody in it was talking, everyone was on their phone. me too. it's fine.
